title: Buy versus lease packaging line
goal: A factory team can compare the trade-offs of buying or leasing a packaging line.

rubric.must: Buy and Lease are visible as parallel option columns.
The table visibly compares cash, maintenance, upgrade, and ownership criteria.
Yes/no and text differences are visually distinguishable.
The grid structure makes row-to-column comparison clear.

ideal.notes: Drafted by Codex from the source, the rubric and the comparison/matrix exemplar, without seeing the engine's own output.

review.evidence: The target shows a clear Buy/Lease comparison table. All four criteria and their corresponding values are visible, readable, and aligned in parallel columns; yes/no states are distinguished with consistent icons and a legend. No blocking defects are visible.

items.evidence: Buy and Lease appear as parallel option columns.
The table includes Up-front cash, Maintenance responsibility, Technology upgrade, and Asset ownership.
Cash and maintenance differences are stated in text; upgrade and ownership use distinct yes/no icons explained by the legend.
All comparison cells are readable, with no visible clipping or overlap.
Alternating row shading and aligned columns make each criterion-to-option comparison clear.
